text: {"assertions":["On 2026-01-30, a NaN feature bug was fixed in ml/features/encoder.py on the ml pipeline side.","The bug only occurred for sessions arriving through the OAuth provider.","The root cause was two writes in the feature encoder that were never wrapped in a transaction.","The fix wrapped both writes in a single transaction, implemented in PR #1025 on branch fix/nan-feature-1.","The bug was reproduced by encoding a batch holding the sparse column.","The symptom of the bug was a not-a-number value appearing in an output column.","After fixing the bug, throughput increased by 71 percent to 335 requests per second.","This NaN feature fix occurred in the same area of ml/features/encoder.py as earlier NaN feature work."]}
